common.tagline: A safe and transparent macOS menu bar cleanup app

index.title: CleanU · Safe, transparent cleanup for macOS
index.description: CleanU is a macOS menu bar disk cleanup app. Read-only scans cover caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives and large files. Review and confirm before cleanup. macOS 13+, with one universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel.
index.intro: Scan caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives and large files. Results are grouped into cache cleanup, project cleanup, app leftovers and storage analysis. Every item shows its path and size. Nothing is cleaned up until you confirm
index.altIdle: CleanU menu bar panel before a scan
index.altReview: CleanU scan results ready for review
index.altSelected: CleanU scan results with items selected
index.featureIntro: One scan brings cleanable items and startup disk usage into one view
index.featureScanBody: One deep scan groups results into caches, project artifacts and app leftovers.
index.featureReviewBody: Every item shows its full path and size, and can be selected individually.
index.safetyReadBody: Scanning reads only directories and file attributes. It never writes, moves or deletes anything.
index.safetyConfirmBody: Candidates are processed only after you explicitly confirm. There is no automatic background cleanup.
index.safetyCheckBody: Candidates are checked again before cleanup. Any item whose path or size no longer matches is excluded.
index.safetyTrashBody: Confirmed files go to the Trash and can be put back. Time Machine snapshots are handled separately using the system's thinning mechanism, not the Trash.
index.safetyPermissionsBody: CleanU runs with the current user's permissions and never asks for an administrator password. Unreadable paths do not appear in the results.
index.pricingIntro: Try it free before you buy
index.pricingUpdatesBody: Future version updates are included in your purchase
index.pricingDevicesBody: Use your license on two Macs you own. Deactivate the old Mac before moving.
index.faqStorage: How is this different from System Settings → Storage?
index.faqStorageBody: System Settings shows storage by category. You can see broad areas of usage, but individual cleanup options are limited. CleanU lists eight sources—caches, temporary files, developer-tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives and large files—with full paths and sizes. Items move to the Trash only after you select and confirm them.
index.faqAccess: Why does CleanU need Full Disk Access?
index.faqAccessBody: Without this permission, macOS blocks some directories, so results may be incomplete and some sources may appear empty. Full Disk Access lets CleanU read caches and artifacts in those locations. Scanning remains read-only, runs with your current user's permissions and never needs an administrator password.
index.faqDeletion: Could it remove something I still need?
index.faqDeletionBefore: Cleanup happens only after you explicitly confirm items you have selected. Candidates are checked again, and mismatches are excluded. Files move to the Trash rather than being permanently deleted, so you can put them back. If you remove project artifacts such as
index.faqDeletionAfter: , you will need to reinstall the project's dependencies before running it again.
index.faqUpload: Will it upload my files or data?
index.faqUploadBody: Scanning, reviewing and cleanup are local file operations on your Mac. Every row corresponds to a real local path, and Time Machine snapshots are read locally too. Cleaned files go to your Mac's Trash; snapshots are the exception and are thinned using the system's mechanism.
index.pricingTax: Taxes, settlement currency, and the final total are shown at Dodo checkout.
index.pricingTrialBody: Full scanning and cleanup for 30 days, without an account. Both require a purchased, activated license after the trial.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · CleanU
privacy.description: Learn how the CleanU macOS app and website handle local data, update requests and website browsing data.
privacy.intro: This policy applies to the CleanU macOS app and the CleanU website. Scanning and cleanup run locally on your Mac; scan results and cleanup history are not uploaded to a server.
privacy.scopeBody: During a scan, CleanU reads directories, file paths and file attributes on your Mac to identify candidates and calculate their sizes. Scanning, review and cleanup happen locally; the app does not upload file contents, scan results or cleanup history. CleanU does not require an account and does not include in-app advertising or analytics SDKs.
privacy.storedBody: To show recent activity and identify app ownership, CleanU may store up to 50 cleanup-operation summaries and up to 2,000 ownership records linking app identifiers to related directories. Operation summaries may include file paths, display names, sizes, categories, outcomes and timestamps; ownership records may also include local directory paths and app identifiers. Preferences are stored locally too.
privacy.locationAfter: . To remove it, quit CleanU, choose “Go → Go to Folder…” in Finder, enter this path and delete the CleanU folder.
privacy.updateBody: When you check for updates, the app requests the public version manifest from the website hosted on Cloudflare Pages. The update request contains no scan results, file paths, cleanup history, or device identifiers. Hosting services may receive IP addresses and request headers. Downloads open the website package or download page.
privacy.websiteBody: The website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Download links and bilingual release notes are generated at build time; your browser does not request the GitHub Release API. Browser local storage keeps your theme choice, and you can clear this website’s browser data. The website does not include advertising or third-party analytics scripts. The hosting service may process ordinary access logs and connection information under its own policies.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Data processed by Dodo, GitHub, and Cloudflare is subject to their privacy policies:
privacy.contactBody: For product help or questions about this policy, visit the support page. GitHub Issues are public; do not post personal information, full file paths, sensitive screenshots or unchecked logs.
privacy.changesBody: If the app's data practices change, we will update the date and information on this page.
privacy.licenseBody: Dodo handles hosted checkout, purchase email addresses, payment information, and license emails. During activation, periodic verification, or deactivation, the app sends Dodo the license key and installation instance ID. Activation also sends a random installation identifier, without computer names, usernames, hardware serial numbers, file paths, scan results, or cleanup history.
privacy.keychainBody: Trial start, installation identifier, license key, instance, check times, and pending operations are stored in the local Keychain without cloud sync. A normal reinstall or deleting Application Support does not also remove Keychain records. Deleting local data does not replace deactivation; only confirmed server deactivation frees a slot.
privacy.returnBody: Dodo may append order, email, or license query parameters to the purchase return URL. The page keeps only an allowlisted status hint, clears the query and fragment early, and does not display or store the raw parameters or load third-party analytics or resources. This cannot remove initial request logs already received by Dodo or the host.

support.title: Support · CleanU
support.description: Get help with CleanU, report a problem or read the release history.
support.intro: Use GitHub Issues for app questions and feature suggestions. For purchases and licensing, use your Dodo purchase email or the official support links below.
support.issueBody: Please include the CleanU version, macOS version, steps to reproduce, expected result and actual result when possible. This helps us investigate.
support.privacyBody: GitHub Issues are public by default. Before posting, review the text, screenshots and logs, and remove usernames, personal file paths, filenames and anything else you do not want to make public. CleanU does not upload diagnostic logs automatically; attach them yourself only after checking that they are safe to share.
support.updatesBody: Visit the home page to download the universal version for Apple Silicon and Intel, or read the release history.
support.purchaseBody: If charged without receiving email, check spam, then use the Dodo customer portal below to find your purchase. If you cannot sign in, entered the wrong email address, or still cannot find the order, open the official Dodo support page.
support.purchaseChannel: If you received your purchase email, use its support option for duplicate charges, full slots, a lost Mac, or activation issues. Share only your purchase email, necessary order details, and a description of the issue. Never post keys or payment details in public Issues.
support.purchaseSteps: Free a slot by deactivating the old Mac. For a lost device or uncertain activation, contact private purchase support. Do not repeatedly purchase if charged.

terms.title: Purchase Terms · CleanU
terms.description: Trial, personal license, offline verification, and refund terms for official CleanU builds.
terms.intro: These terms apply to license-compatible official CleanU builds. Try the app and confirm it meets your needs on your Mac before purchasing.
terms.trialBody: The continuous 30-day trial starts when you click Start Trial and its start time is successfully saved. No account is needed. Scanning and cleanup are fully available during the trial, and both lock afterward until purchase and activation. A normal reinstall or language change does not reset it.
terms.licenseBody: Purchase provides a personal license with no preset expiration and includes future updates, without a recurring subscription. Taxes, settlement currency, and the final total appear at Dodo checkout. Continued validity depends on active installations, verification, and any revocation required by law or platform rules.
terms.devicesBody: One personal license permits at most two concurrent installation instances and may not be resold or shared between people. Deactivate an old Mac before moving. Other OS users, virtual machines, or reinstalling after losing local records may create another instance. The limit does not verify identity. Contact private support for a lost device.
terms.connectionBody: Internet is required for first activation and periodic license verification. You can use CleanU offline for up to seven days after the last successful check. After that, connect and verify to resume scanning and cleanup. Deactivation or revocation after a successful paid activation does not automatically restore the trial.
terms.refundBody: A full trial is available, so discretionary refunds for changing your mind or not using the software are not offered. Exceptions required by applicable law or the payment platform remain available. Use your purchase email or the official Dodo support links below for duplicate charges, non-delivery, or other order problems.
terms.supportBody: Dodo handles payment and license email delivery. A browser return status is not order verification or successful activation. Keep your purchase email; if it is missing, use the customer portal or official support page below to find and check your order. Never publish keys or card details; scan results, file contents, and hardware serial numbers are not needed.
terms.sourceBody: This purchase policy applies to official builds. Source use remains governed by the repository LICENSE. Buying a license does not change the source license or retroactively change previously released versions.
